title: [YSQL] Fix test failure "Failing test because we had to kill stuck process."
body:
Jira Link: [DB-3589](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3589)
### Description

There are many matches of test log error "Failing test because we had to kill stuck process."  The error code appears to have been around for a long time (build-support/run-test.sh), so there might be a regression somewhere.  It tends to be postgres process that's stuck.
